title: The Emperor Who Vanished
sentences: The last Roman emperor was last seen in the final battle, and his body was never identified for certain.
Constantine the Eleventh refused to leave Constantinople.
Several accounts say he threw off his imperial regalia and plunged into the fighting.
One Ottoman account says soldiers killed him without knowing who he was.
Others say a head was brought to Mehmed as the emperor's.
Greek legend said he was turned to marble, waiting to return.
Follow for more from the fall of Constantinople.
